name: Return to Tristram
author: Adam
description: Adds a Hell-only Act V endgame loop: farm Demonic Essence from the Countess, cube a Rift Key, open a Red Portal to the Worldstone Rift (Tier I), kill Vharzak the Rift Guardian, and cube his Corrupted Essence into Heart of Tristram, a new Mythic charm.

parameters.name: Enable Return to Tristram
parameters.description: Master switch for the whole content pack: Demonic/Corrupted Essence, the Worldstone Rift Key, the Worldstone Rift (Tier I) level, Vharzak the Rift Guardian, and Heart of Tristram. Turn this off to disable everything below.

parameters.name: Dev shortcut: Scroll of Town Portal + Scroll of Identify = Rift Key
parameters.description: Testing convenience only: adds a second, much cheaper recipe for the Worldstone Rift Key T1 so you can reach the Rift without farming the Countess. Leave this off for normal play.
